# testdata

## ZEXALL and ZEXDOC

`zexall.com` and `zexdoc.com` are the Z80 instruction exercisers written by
Frank D. Cringle, originally for his YAZE (Yet Another Z80 Emulator), and
ported to CP/M by J.G. Harston.

- **ZEXDOC** tests all documented Z80 instructions and flag behaviours.
- **ZEXALL** additionally tests undocumented opcodes and flag bits (F3/F5,
  SCF/CCF quirks, MEMPTR, IXH/IXL, SLL, etc.).

**License:** GNU General Public License (GPL).

**Source and binaries:** <https://mdfs.net/Software/Z80/Exerciser/>

The binaries are widely used across the Z80 emulation community as a de facto
correctness standard.
